**s3:ListObject**.\\n\\nResolution\\n----------\\n\\nTo resolve an **AccessDenied** error, take the following actions based on your scenario\",\"url\":\"https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/sagemaker-s3-accessdenied-training\"},{\"rank_order\":2,\"title\":\"How do I troubleshoot Amazon S3 Batch Operations
